# Shine MP3 encoder

This directory contains the `src/lib` encoder from [toots/shine](https://github.com/toots/shine),
pinned to commit `ab5e3526b64af1a2eaa43aa6f441a7312e013519`. It is used by the local ICY radio
stream to encode the captured Spotify output as MPEG Layer III.

The library is licensed under the GNU Library General Public License, version 2; see
[`COPYING`](./COPYING). Source files are retained so recipients can rebuild the library.
